summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Buys Streaming Show ‘TBPN,’ Aiming to Change Narrative on A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Claude Code leak used to push infostealer malware on GitHub
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 38 articles published in the last 24 hours
